**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

The document imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation on Bluefly. § 14.8 (Personnel), the natural home for such a covenant, deals only with supervision, IBM's assignment rights and subcontracting, and § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms each party may enter similar agreements with others. Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", and "induce" surfaced no restrictive covenant anywhere in the agreement. This sits at the playbook's preferred position, so nothing needs to change.
